## Adaptation and source-work clues
- When a clue names or describes a parody, adaptation, retelling, remake, or modernized work, check whether it implicitly asks for the original or source work. Use context and any stated title transformation, such as a word being changed or substituted, to identify the requested source; reverse the transformation and return the original work or title when the source is requested, rather than repeating the altered adaptation or giving its type or creator.
